definitionZh: 嵌入式 CSS 短手属性定义了元素的逻辑内线起始和末端的嵌入式,根据元素的写法模式,方向,以及文本方向,将嵌入式属性映射到物理上.
sourceDefinition: The padding-inline CSS shorthand property defines the logical inline start and end padding of an element, which maps to physical padding properties depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
